    'Haider-e-Karrar', 'Shair-e-Ali', 'Mashk-e-Sakina', 'Parcham-e-Abbas',

item.text:
Reconstructed all 62 verses in Urdu script and verified that they align line by line with the original Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. Preserved the existing stanza numbering and refrains, removed the duplicate title line from the verses, set the direction to RTL, and cleared `noUrdu`.

I read “La Fatah” as «لا فتیٰ» and “Alh Aslam” as «علیہ السلام». Only the selected lyric was edited.
